summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did:** Read-only audit of the full chain (no edits made): `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `useAuth.tsx` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus a live Bun test of the one thing that looked suspicious (mutating request headers in middleware).  **What I found, which changes the shape of this ticket:** The chain, as it exists right now, looks correctly wired: - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie is always attached.
